objective: Independently read all 74 frozen comparator pairs against complete archived records, freezing independent judgments before any prior labels. Preserve a complete bounded checkpoint if 1800 scientific seconds elapse.
before_freeze: Read the operating protocol and only the source-only packet, generic protocol and work order for evidence. Do not read the comparator README, any first-reader note/checkpoint, handover, portfolio summaries or selected evidence before freezing.
Read complete eligibility, descriptions, conditions, arms/cohorts, design, status and interventions; resolve cross-module conflicts and preserve cohort/phase applicability.

Write source-linked labels, exact quotes and JSON pointers, separate molecular/variant requirements, external protocol uncertainty, study purpose and snapshot availability. Distinguish scope from active cohort availability and individual eligibility.

Record actual execution metadata and inspected IDs. Freeze source/output hashes and timestamp before consulting any first-reader judgments. Procedural separation is not technical blinding or human clinical review.
after_freeze: Compare only independently frozen IDs with the corresponding immutable first-reader notes. Preserve both readers and source-grounded dispositions for every substantive field difference.
Keep unresolved differences uncertain. No performance-based label tuning, retrieval evaluation, patient eligibility or treatment advice.
coordination: No nested workers, outgoing status messages, network, installs, changes outside output scope, commits or preflight. Coordinator retains ownership and polls.
completion_limit: An intermediate checkpoint is not a finished adjudicated reference or preprint; preserve unfinished IDs explicitly.
